about: Reviewed note aliases (owner request, 9 Oct 2026). Each entry says a spelling is the SAME ingredient as another note and is shown under the canonical name everywhere on the site. APPEND ONLY, like data/id-aliases.json: never delete an entry, never change a canonical (a published /notes/<slug> address of a merged spelling redirects to its canonical, so the entry is also that address memory). To add: append to aliases, run the tests, rebuild (npm run catalogue:demo). Origins, parts and accords stay their own notes (keepApart). See docs/NOTES-PAGE-PLAN.md section B.

kinds.plural: Musks is Musk. A plural is the same ingredient.
kinds.order: Pepper Pink is Pink Pepper. Word order.
kinds.form: Absolute, essence, oil, extract, concrete, CO2, resinoid or a supplier label (Orpur, SFE) of X is X.
kinds.country: Italy Lemon is Italian Lemon. The country and its nationality word.
kinds.spelling: A misspelling or a variant spelling of one word.
kinds.synonym: Two names for one material, or filler words around it. The reason says which.
